connector.name: Nora
connector.registryDescription: Operate self-hosted OpenClaw and Hermes agent fleets on Docker or Kubernetes from MCP clients.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package mcp-server. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the solomon2773 account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: NORA_API_URL
env.description: Base URL of your Nora backend API (e.g. https://nora.example.com). Falls back to NORA_HOST, then the Nora CLI config at ~/.nora/config.json.

env.name: NORA_API_KEY
env.description: Nora workspace API key (nora_…) used to authenticate against the Nora public REST API. Falls back to NORA_TOKEN, then the Nora CLI config.

env.name: NORA_MCP_ALLOW_DESTRUCTIVE
env.description: Set to "true" to enable destructive tools (e.g. delete_agent). Disabled by default.
